description: Create a PDF from plain text. Honours line breaks (\n) and treats blank lines as paragraph breaks. Long lines wrap automatically.

fontPath.description: Absolute path of the font file to embed (.ttf / .otf). Required for non-Latin text such as Japanese. .ttc (TrueType Collection) is not supported. Can also be set via the PDF_WRITER_FONT environment variable.

lang.description: Natural language of the document (BCP 47, e.g. "ja" / "en-US"). When omitted with tagged, it is inferred from the text and the guess is reported in warnings. A wrong language declaration makes screen readers misread — state it explicitly when you know it.

margin.description: Margin on all sides (pt). Default 56 (about 20 mm). Range 0-300.

onMissingGlyph.description: What to do with characters the font lacks (e.g. ✔ U+2714, missing from Noto Sans JP). error (default) = fail, listing the missing characters / replace = substitute 〓 with a warning / ignore = render as blanks with a warning.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

pdfVersion.description: PDF version to output. Default "1.7". "2.0" (ISO 32000-2) satisfies not just the version claim but the duties bound to it: a trailer /ID is added (Required per Table 15), and the Info dictionary is trimmed to CreationDate / ModDate with title, author and Producer moved to XMP (§14.3.3). Cannot be combined with tagged: true (the only declaration the writer can produce is PDF/UA-1, built on PDF 1.7).

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

tagged.description: Generate as a tagged PDF (PDF/UA-1, ISO 14289). Default false. When true, a structure tree, the PDF/UA declaration, /Lang and DisplayDocTitle are added, making the document readable by screen readers. PDF/UA requires a title, so title becomes required.

text.description: Body text. \n breaks lines; blank lines separate paragraphs.

title.description: PDF title. Set in the metadata and also drawn as a heading at the top of the body.

name: create_text_pdf
title: Create PDF from Plain Text
